title: Beach Yoga & Tea Experience on South Beach
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Bring a a beach towel to do yoga on (since we are on sand, towel is better than yoga mat).
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Yoga is as much a physical journey as it is spiritual. I help my students to develop their practices for deep healing, transformation and, most importantly, relaxation. Through mindful sequences that emphasize alignment and the synchronization of breath and movement, students of all levels are encouraged to find and express themselves with their practice. Our goal of inspiring others makes us extra-aware of the students’ different levels and needs, encouraging them with gentle adjustments. In addition to being an entrepreneur, I'm an earnest student of life aiming to expand my mindset and implement healthy thinking habits through learning mindfulness and aiming for excellence.
